title: 毎日王冠の後に・我等、此処に集いて

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's Mejiro Ardan! Mejiro Ardan has overtaken Oguri Cap! She's taken the lead!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Although I claimed victory, Oguri really was quite the formidable opponent! She's truly one of the greats of our time!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That was an incredible performance. It looks like I was still underestimating you.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sheesh, I can't afford to give you an inch, huh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I felt it in your running—a desire to barrel through and pulverize everything. That's not something I get to witness every day.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What about the autumn Tenno Sho? You'll be there, right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Then that's where I'll beat you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Likewise, Oguri. I wouldn't have it any other way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan and Oguri Cap reaffirm their mutual desire to face off again, and the Mainichi Okan draws to a close.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (This should be the location Yaeno specified… but she doesn't appear to have arrived yet.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: What are you doing here? Yaeno said—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I see. Yaeno must have asked us both to come here.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming all the way out here. I arranged this meeting so I could give you something.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. We'll meet at the upcoming autumn Tenno Sho… Us and Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let's settle our score there, up against the spearhead of the Eternal Top Three. Once and for all, we will see which of us is the finest racer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Why not show the world that we are the true top three?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: My sincerest apologies. I was simply unable to contain the sheer joy I felt upon hearing so wonderful a proposition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: We shall settle this rivalry between us at the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …And what will you do, Chiyono O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I accept the challenge too! Let's see who can seize the top spot!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I expected nothing less from my finest rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (It's times like these that remind me…)
